corrections.reason: Traditional Andemta idiom 'መሥረት መቅጻት' (to appoint/establish and to punish); the glyph is 1st-order 'ረ', not 4th-order 'ራ'.
Traditional Andemta idiom 'መሥረት መቅጻት' (to appoint/establish and to punish); the glyph in the image is 1st-order 'ረ', not 4th-order 'ራ'.
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 17:17 'አምጽእዎ ሊተ ዝየ' (translated in L28 as 'አምጣልኝ' with object suffix). The image clearly shows two characters 'እዎ' after 'አምጽ'.
